items.title: Rebecca Kilgore interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: I’ve performed several times, he’s just a joy, so that’s a real thrill.

ctx.x: Well with Bob Haggart. I consider him an elderstatesman for sure. I’ve performed several times, he’s just a joy, so that’s a real thrill. And Scott Hamilton, Dave McKenna, all these folks are great. They’re not “elder” yet, but they will be.
Yeah, and on the other hand it’s nice to see Harry Allen and Jon-Erik [Kellso] coming in and doing this kind of music.
